name: ST Digital Data Center Services - Nkok DC (lbv01)
notes: Gabon's first sovereign Tier III data center inside the Nkok Special Economic Zone (~23-30 km from Libreville); opened/inaugurated 30 Jun-3 Jul 2026 after Aug 2025 groundbreaking; operator page (A): 100% operational, 1 MW, solar/green design, water-free cooling, colocation/IaaS/SaaS; press (B): ~8 bn FCFA, >3,000 m2, 92 racks; Tier III 'Certified' is operator/press claim - no Uptime record located for lbv01 yet.

name: Cybastion / Government of Gabon / ANINF sovereign data center (reported 20 MW)
developer: Cybastion (with ANINF and Porteo; Cisco/Citibank/EXIM financing)
notes: State/ANINF convention signed 28 Jun 2025 (strategic agreement first reported 28 Jan 2025); national sovereign DC reported at 20 MW with a gas power plant; site reported in the Nkok SEZ / Libreville-Nkok corridor, exact site unresolved; DCD notes ST Digital as would-be operator; keep separate from ST Digital lbv01 until an official ownership statement merges them; Gabon is seeking US financing for ~200 MW additional power for AI/industrial projects.

name: Moov Africa Gabon Telecom DC1 (Cenacom Building, Libreville)
developer: Moov Africa Gabon Telecom (Maroc Telecom group)
notes: Legacy telco data center; the only Uptime Institute record located for Gabon (DC1, Cenacom Building, Libreville); tier level and certification date still to be confirmed on the Uptime list; GABIX POP CT-1 is hosted at/near the Cenacom building; third-party colocation offering unconfirmed.

name: ANINF national data center programme (Libreville)
developer: ANINF (Agence Nationale des Infrastructures Numeriques et des Frequences)
notes: State national-DC programme record (A-grade for programme intent, C for facility identity); physical site/operator unresolved - keep separate from ST Digital Nkok and the Cybastion agreement unless ownership/address evidence merges them; AfDB 2018 grant covered national-DC feasibility.

name: Airtel Gabon S.A. data center (Libreville)
notes: Directory-listed Airtel Gabon facility in Libreville (C-grade); PeeringDB org record exists (network presence) and Airtel is a GABIX member; needs operator/ARCEP confirmation before counting as public colocation.
